result:
The disk filled up and the database took the api down with it: the `report-export` job wrote 40 CSV parts of 512 MB each (about 20 GB) into `/var/lib/stockroom/exports/` between 03:05:00 and 03:12:48, pushing `/var/lib/stockroom` to 91% at 03:09:03 and 99% at 03:13:30.

The deciding line is at 03:14:00: `ERROR db: could not extend file "base/16384/2619": No space left on device`. Three seconds later the api logged `transaction aborted, shutting down worker pool`, and at 03:14:06 `FATAL api: exiting (status 1)`.

The api never came back within this log. There are no api lines after 03:14:06, and the proxy logs `upstream api refused connection` every two minutes from 03:16:00 through 05:28:00, just before the log ends at 05:29:57.

The `cache: slow command` warnings are unrelated: they run every five minutes or so from 02:00 at the same 100–150 ms, before and after the crash.

To recover, free space in `/var/lib/stockroom/exports/`, then restart the api, since nothing restarted it on its own. The export job isn't defined in this repo, so I couldn't see why it wrote that much; to prevent a repeat, it needs a size cap or an export directory on a volume separate from the database.
